name: pulse
description: Show Claude Code's 5-hour/weekly usage in the status bar.

pulse.refreshInterval.description: Usage refresh interval in seconds. Minimum 10 seconds.

pulse.warnThreshold.description: Show the status bar in the warning color at or above this utilization (0-1).

pulse.alertThreshold.description: Show the status bar in the error color at or above this utilization (0-1).

pulse.showTokens.description: Show token usage in the tooltip: today's totals, with the 7-day / 30-day totals and trend behind the "7d / 30d ▸" link. Computed locally from the Claude Code transcripts under ~/.claude/projects and kept in ~/.pulse/token-history.json (override with PULSE_HOME).
